items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: So, that's where I started playing with Thomas. Well, I played with Thomas about, oh, a couple of years I fooled around with Thomas.

ctx.x: And we started playing off, uh, little dances and things like that. Who played guitar? Well, after, uh, after Red Island, left and went to New York, I took up with Kit Thomas.
Mm-hmm. Well, tell me about the band with Red Island. What were you playing?
